ownership_rule: The project owns this database; no application owns it or its table. A shot analysis reaches it only through the one intermediary of the project database (qnc.module.db-broker), whose table module qnc.module.shot-db owns it.

rules.clip: A row is the shot analysis of one clip: its shots one after another as clip frames [from, to), each with its looks (black, soft, moving, still) and its sharpest frame, the medium the pictures came from and how many; or only why the clip could not be analysed (user 2026-10-27).
rules.replace: A clip analysed again replaces its row.
rules.parts: With the shots a row keeps the usable parts of the take: clip frames [from, to) where the camera stands or pans evenly, sharp and not black, inside one shot, at least 3 s, with how the camera holds it (steady, pan) and its sharpest frame (user 2026-10-27).
rules.version: A row carries the analysis version; a row of another version is analysed again, a table of the earlier form without parts is removed.
